idea: How to prevent bathroom pipe problems
title: Simple Habits to Protect Your Bathroom Plumbing
description: Preventing bathroom plumbing issues starts with a few daily habits. First, place drain catchers in your shower and sink to trap hair and soap scum before they cause stubborn clogs. Never flush items like wipes, cotton swabs, or facial tissues, even if they claim to be flushable. Regularly check under the sink for small drips or moisture, as minor leaks can slowly damage cabinets and subflooring over time. Finally, avoid relying on harsh chemical drain cleaners, which can degrade your pipes over time. If you notice slow drains or unusual noises, schedule a routine inspection with a licensed plumber to address minor issues early.
